text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Today's weather is clear and sunny! It's 
a perfect day for observing Umamusume, 
isn't it?♪"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha!? Digi-tan's Umamusume sensor is 
reacting already! I must make haste!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Lady Sirius~! Where are youuu!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Today, please run alongside me to your 
heart's content and "dote on" me~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's quite noisy, isn't it? ...Well, it 
doesn't seem to concern a princess like 
me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, let our special training begin! O 
great tree, receive it upon your trunk 
once more today—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Princess☆Slap!
What the!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I shook the tree and instead of a 
rhinoceros beetle—Sirius-san fell down?!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"...Even for me, being treated like a 
rhinoceros beetle is a first."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Just when I thought I was 
finally alone, a surprise ambusher shows 
up.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My, how unusual. You are always surrounded 
by people, so I assumed you preferred that 
kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I just want some time to think 
to myself. So keep my whereabouts a secret 
from those guys, got it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If you have no intention of listening— 
then I'll just have to silence you by 
force.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, a chin lift!? N-No way, not that...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Now, what will you do, my little tomboy 
princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: How scandalous!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...T-There's a giant hole... in the 
wall...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Oh goodness, I've gone and done it 
again~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, teachers!! I'll write an 
apology letter right away, waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ghk, heh-heh...! Hahaha...!!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess, huh? ...Interesting 
one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaaaa~t?! I just got an "interestin' 
one" from a cool Umamusume~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-Tracen Academy is a treasure trove of 
wonderful scenarios again today... 
*collapse*!
